description:
ServiceNow Developer 
 Req number: 
R9022 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Hybrid 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
Learn how to analyze and resolve problems or events of simple complexity in support of CAI customers 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a ServiceNow Developer to expand and support a recently implemented ServiceNow platform, focusing on Service Request and Change Management. This position will be a full-time contract and hybrid in Columbia, SC. 
 What You'll Do 
 Collaborate with IT staff and departments to gather requirements and recommend solutions utilizing standard ServiceNow capabilities
 Configure Service Catalog items, request forms, approval workflows, fulfillment processes, and Change Management solutions
 Develop, maintain, and enhance ServiceNow workflows, business rules, scripting, automation, and integrations
 Create and support integrations with enterprise systems including Cisco Contact Center platforms
 Test, troubleshoot, document, and deploy platform enhancements through development, testing, and production environments
 Evaluate and improve existing ServiceNow functionality and platform performance
 Support implementation and integration of AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem
 Provide documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to internal staff
 Assist with future platform expansion initiatives and continuous process improvement
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 3+ years of experience implementing ServiceNow Service Catalog and Request Fulfillment solutions in a production environment
 3+ years of ServiceNow configuration and development experience, including workflow automation, business rules, and access controls
 3+ years of experience gathering requirements and translating business processes into sustainable technical solutions
 3+ years of experience with JavaScript, REST APIs, and integration troubleshooting
 3+ years of experience testing, documenting, and deploying ServiceNow enhancements across development, test, and production environments
 Strong communication, problem-solving, organizational, and collaboration skills
 Ability to clearly explain technical concepts and provide hands-on training and documentation
 Relevant education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
 Preferred:
 Experience building integrations and automated workflows between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using Integration Hub
 Experience implementing ServiceNow AI capabilities or integrating external AI services
 Experience integrating ServiceNow with Cisco Contact Center platforms
 Familiarity with CMDB, service relationships, and their role in Change Management
 Experience supporting higher education institutions or public-sector organizations
 Relevant ServiceNow certifications
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional movement throughout the workplace
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
 #LI-KW1 
 
 Reasonable accommodation statement 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
